! He took Danger! Lunalight Orcust – a Deck that has been rising in popularity since YCS Portland some weeks ago – to a win here in Mexico.

, a former Mexican National Champion brought Magical Musketeer to the YCS and showed that the strategy can still stand up to current competitive options, while
brought their A-game to the tournament and made it to Day 2 or into the playoffs!

We’ll see you all next weekend for YCS Ft. Worth!
